Theme

Conversation, family & daily routines · Body, health & movement

tired adjective

also tiredness, I’m so tired, fatigued

classical

Traupman 35, 39
Traupman 313

fessus, fessa, fessum

Other words

  • fatīgātus, fatīgāta, fatīgātum — worn out, exhausted

    adjective (participle of fatīgō) · also used · classical · Lewis & Short, s.v. fatīgō; Andresian p. 36

    Wearied by something; stronger than fessus, and rare before Augustus (Lewis & Short).

Examples

  • Fessus es?

    Are you tired? Said to a boy.composed

  • Fessa es?

    Are you tired? Said to a girl.composed

  • Tam fessa sum.

    I’m so tired.Traupman 35

See also rest, run, pant, sleepy.

SourcesLewis & Short: fessus
